info.title: Stacks
info.description: The Stacks API: track movies, shows, anime and Asian dramas. Every operation, schema and status here is derived from the types the server runs on. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents.

authorization_url.description:
The identity provider's authorization URL, carrying this request's
`state`, nonce and PKCE challenge.

OidcAuthorization.description: Where to send the browser to sign in.

NewSession.description: What the identity provider redirected back with.

current.description: Whether this is the session the request was made with.

user_agent.description: The browser's `User-Agent` when it signed in.

ip.description: The client address when it signed in.

ScoreFormat.description: How scores are shown and entered. Stored scores are always 0–100.

TitleLanguage.description: Which title to show for titles that have several.

Spoilers.description: Whether episode titles and overviews past the caller's progress show.

email.description: The email the identity provider reported, if any.

CurrentSession.description: The session a request was made with, and who it belongs to.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

PreferencesPatch.description: A change to the caller's preferences. Members left out are unchanged.

UserPatch.description: A change to the caller's account. Members left out are unchanged.

TokenScope.description: A scope an API token can be granted.

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to recognise it by.

expires_at.description: `null` for a token that never expires.

ApiToken.description: An API token, without its secret.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

expires_at.description: When the token stops working; `null` or absent for never.

secret.description:
The secret, shown this once and never again. Send it as
`Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

CreatedApiToken.description: A token just created, with its secret.

Kind.description: Whether a title is a single film or an episodic show.

Category.description:
The browsing category, derived from provider, format, origin country and
genre.

TitleRef.description: A title reference, `<provider>:<kind>:<id>`: provider `tmdb` or `anilist`, kind `movie` or `show`.

rewatching.description: Whether the caller is on a rewatch.

LibraryState.description: The caller's relationship with a title, when it is in their library.

ref.description: The title's reference, which every title-scoped operation takes.

original_title.description: The original-language title, when it differs from `title`.

year.description: The release year, or the first-air year of a show.

rating.description: The provider's rating out of 10, when it has one.

library.description: `null` when the title is not in the caller's library.

TitleSummary.description: A title, as listings show it.

Degradation.description: One provider call that failed while a listing was assembled.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

degraded.description: The provider calls that failed; the items are what the rest returned.

unreadable.description:
How many upstream entries could not be read and are missing from
`items`.

TitlePage.description: One page of titles assembled from the metadata providers.

stale.description: `true` when the provider failed and the stored snapshot was served.

fetched_at.description: When the data was last fetched from the provider, if ever.

Freshness.description: Whether a read came live from the provider or from the stored snapshot.

runtime_minutes.description: The film's runtime, or a show's typical episode runtime, in minutes.

release_status.description: The release status, as the provider words it.

in_production.description: Shows only: whether new episodes are still being made.

episode_count.description: `null` when the provider did not say.

Season.description: One season of a show. Specials are season 0.

rating.description: The provider's rating out of 10, when it has one.

ImportSource.description: Where an upload came from, which says how it is read.

ConflictStrategy.description: What an import does to a title already in the library.

ImportCounts.description: How an import's rows turned out. Filled in when the import completes.

filename.description: The uploaded file's name, when the upload gave one.

size.description: The uploaded file's size in bytes.

error.description: Why the import failed, when it did.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

row.description: The row's position in the file, from 1.

title.description: The title the row was matched to; `null` when none was.

error.description: Why the row failed, when it did.

items.description: Empty until the worker has read the file.

ImportDetail.description: An import with its rows, in file order.

ImportItemResolution.description: A row's match, chosen by hand.

progress.description: Episodes watched in the current run, for a show.

started_on.description: When the first watch started, if recorded.

completed_on.description: When the first watch was completed, if recorded.

BackupEntry.description: One library entry in a backup.

version.description: The backup format; 1 for this one.

entries.description: Every live entry, most recently updated first.

Backup.description:
A backup of the caller's library.

Version 1 carries each live entry's status, score, current progress and
first run's dates. It does not carry rewatches, individual plays, notes,
tags, lists or the blocklist.

YearCount.description: Watch runs completed in one calendar year.

year.description: The year the activity figures are limited to; `null` for all time.

by_status.description: Library entries per status, omitting statuses with none.

by_category.description: Library entries per category, omitting categories with none.

watch_time_minutes.description: Minutes watched, from each play's episode (or title) runtime.

completions_by_year.description: Watch runs completed per year, oldest first (a rewatch counts again).

top_genres.description: Genres of completed titles, most frequent first.

Stats.description:
The caller's statistics.

`by_status` and `by_category` describe the library as it stands; the
rest is activity, limited to `year` when one was asked for.

WebhookMethod.description: The method a webhook is delivered with.

header_names.description: The names of the extra headers sent; their values are not shown.

tags.description: The Apprise tags notified; empty for all of the key's.

ChannelConfig.description: A channel's configuration as read back: its secrets are not shown.

enabled.description: A disabled channel receives nothing, whatever it is subscribed to.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

headers.description:
Extra headers sent with every delivery, such as an
`Authorization` the receiver expects.

secret.description:
When set, each delivery's body is signed with HMAC-SHA256 under
this secret, the hex digest sent as `X-Stacks-Signature`.

oneOf.description: A JSON `POST` (or `PUT`, `PATCH`) of each notification to a URL.

url.description:
An absolute `http` or `https` URL, such as
`https://apprise.example.com/notify/{key}`.

tags.description: Apprise tags to notify; all of the key's when left out.

NewChannelConfig.description: A channel's configuration as written: what it delivers to, by type.

headers.description: Replaces every extra header; `null` removes them all.

ChannelConfigPatch.description:
A change to a channel's configuration. Its `type` must be the channel's
own; members left out are unchanged, and `null` clears an optional one.

ChannelPatch.description: A change to a channel. Members left out are unchanged.

NotificationEvent.description: An event a channel can be notified of.

Subscription.description: One event type routed to one channel.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

SubscriptionPatch.description: A change to a subscription. Members left out are unchanged.

email.description: The email the identity provider reported, if any.

deactivated_at.description: When the account was deactivated; `null` while it is active.

AdminUser.description: An account, as an administrator sees it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

deactivated.description:
`true` stops the account authenticating and ends every one of its
sessions; `false` lets it sign in again. Its data is untouched either
way.

AdminUserPatch.description: A change to an account. Members left out are unchanged.

JobStatus.description: Where a job is in the queue.

max_attempts.description: Attempts allowed before the job fails for good.

run_at.description: When the job is next due to run.

started_at.description: When the current or last attempt started.

completed_at.description: When the job completed or failed for good.

error.description: The last attempt's failure, if any.

Job.description:
A background job. Its payload is not shown: it can carry what a job
needs and nobody else should read.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` on the last page.

Readiness.description:
The service can take traffic.

Metadata providers are reported and never make the service unready: the
library is served from the catalog snapshot while they are down.

ApiToken.description: A personal API token (`stk_…`), created with `createApiToken`. Each operation names the scope it needs.
